__comment: A cube_all whose faces carry tintindex 1, so a block colour handler can tint the casing texture
without touching the rest of a machine part's model.
Why this file exists: the vanilla parent `block/cube_all` has no tint layer at all, so a colour
handler would have nothing to colour. The original did the same thing one level down — its
`blocklifeessenceprovider*.json`, which embed that element), and only that texture layer was tinted;
the machine's own overlay textures were not.
Face order and uv/v values are the vanilla cube_all template's, so switching a model's parent from
`minecraft:block/cube_all` to this one changes nothing about its geometry.
